title: Deep Blue defeats Garry Kasparov
summary: IBM's Deep Blue defeated reigning world chess champion Garry Kasparov in a six-game match completed on 11 May 1997, winning 3.5 to 2.5 under standard tournament time controls.
significance: A documented computer-chess milestone: IBM records the result as the first time a reigning world chess champion lost a match to a computer opponent in tournament play.

geography.note: IBM's Deep Blue history records the 1997 rematch at the Equitable Center in New York City.

verification.note: IBM's 1997 Annual Report dates the match victory to 11 May 1997 and records the first-in-tournament-play claim; IBM's Deep Blue history corroborates the 3.5–2.5 result, standard tournament time controls, and New York event context.
